name: Medina de Pomar (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally by a blue wavy band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above with the crowned municipal arms of Medina de Pomar (a castle and a tree) in the upper fly, and red below.
history: Municipal flag of Medina de Pomar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
